lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Two parallel horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots are visible; the inferior row displays higher contrast and more uniform spacing compared to the superior row.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of spots, creating a grid-like arrangement most visible at the intersection points with the lower row of blobs.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge feature runs along the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with high luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: The upper lobe of the caudal fin contains distinct high-luminance circular blobs arranged linearly along its anterior edge.
